name: skill-evals
description: Execution-quality evals for the skills in this repository. See DESIGN.md.

scripts.specify:eval: cd specify && promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --repeat 5 -o results/$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S).json
scripts.specify:eval:control: cd specify && EVAL_ARM=control promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --repeat 5 -o results/control-$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S).json
